rows.abstract: Aims to assure credit availability and accessibility to the smal farmers by: (1) imposing a P1.5 million capitalization ceiling for agri-agra qualified borrowers; (2) deleting the distinction between agriculture and agrarian reform credits; (3) deleting investment in government securities; (4) broadening alternative compliance options by purchase of DBP and LBP bonds and special deposit accounts, etc. and (5) expanding the conduit network to inlcude government institutions (DBP and LBP), etc.

rows.title_full: AN ACT RESTRUCTURING THE EXCISE TAX ON PETROLEUM PRODUCTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PERTINENT SECTIONS OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Decreases the present rate of 10% ad valorem duty to 3% and consolidates into the specific tax the 7% difference, and the P0.95 special levy; reduces the excise tax imposed on indigenous etroleum from 15% to 3% of the fair international market price.  Provides for a uniform level of protection across all sectors, promotes global competition and simplifies the tariff structure for ease in customs administration. Is in line with the government's oil industry deregulation and liberalization program.

rows.abstract: Declares that a BANK ROBBERY committed by BANK OFFICIALS or employees, or with their knowledge or in connivance with other persons, or by former or active MILITARY personnel, or by active or former POLICE personnel shall be punishable with RECLUSIONPERPETUA to DEATH.
